cycles.trigger: Editor update cycle: 2025 Derech Shava fare reform + 2026 EMV/app ticketing shift + stale fees and dead links.
changes: Added a Public Transport Fares section (Derech Shava): single urban ride with a 90-minute transfer, distance bands (15/40/75/120/225 km), a daily cap, a nationwide monthly, and seniors free at 67-plus. Added to SKILL.md, SKILL_HE.md, and references.
Documented EMV contactless plus remote app loading (Rav-Kav Online / HopOn / Rav-Pass) and softened the Rav-Kav gotcha which previously implied kiosk-or-driver-only loading.
Corrected the Egged 421 Tel Aviv to Dead Sea fare downward to the distance-capped reform band.
Updated national park fees: single entry band, tourist cards (Blue/Green/Orange), and the Matmon annual subscription; re-labeled the references pricing header to verify current year.
Fixed dead links: afikim.co.il to electra-afikim.co.il (Electra rebrand) and rav-kav.co.il to ravkavonline.co.il plus ravpass.co.il.
Added Acre-Karmiel and Haifa-Beit She'an rail lines to the Israel Railways routes (D1).
Deepened metadata.json display_description.he with EN anchors (Dead Sea, Eilat, Egged/Dan/Kavim, Derech Shava, seasonal tips) (D2).
Re-dated the references gas price to the May 2026 regulated 95-octane self-service maximum (D3).
Created evidence.json (cited claims) and this optimization-log.json.
deviations: Task suggested a nationwide monthly around the 225 distance band figure; the authoritative current price (ravkavonline.co.il + pti.org.il) for the Chofshi Artzi up-to-225-km unlimited monthly is higher. Wrote the verified price. The lower figure appears to come from an earlier reform phase or a band label rather than the current monthly price.
Task suggested the Dead Sea 421 fare near the upper end of the up-to-120-km band; the verified band cap is one shekel lower. Wrote the verified band cap to stay within evidence.
Task suggested a single park entry band; verified Ein Gedi at the low end and a spread across sites. Wrote the verified spread.

cycles.trigger: Panel review: headline updates correct but several figures mis-cited or stale. Re-verified each via WebFetch/Playwright against authoritative current sources.
changes: CORRECTED the distance-band single-ride fares to the current post-25-April-2025 pti.org.il tariff (bus only): replaced the stale pre-reform set with the verified per-band single fares and per-band daily caps in SKILL.md, SKILL_HE.md, references, and domain-checklist.
SOFTENED the EMV rollout to early-2026 pilot in Eilat, Jerusalem and Haifa (removed the uncorroborated exact Jan 11 / Jan 18 dates).
BROADENED the EMV section: added Israel Railways tap-at-gates and Dan central-Israel contactless since October 2022, so it is no longer presented as Egged-bus-only (expert MAJOR 9).
CORRECTED the national-park single-entry range to the real 2025 INPA spread for the main tourist sites, sourced to parks.org.il/article/price (Ein Gedi, Masada, Caesarea verified via Playwright).
RE-SOURCED the Matmon annual to the confirmed individual tier only; couple/family hedged as costing more (could not confirm those tiers on the official page).
RE-SOURCED Eilat VAT-free to the Israeli Tax Authority 18% rate (raised from 17% on 1 Jan 2025).

REMOVED the fabricated per-chain hotel shekel ranges and the example nightly figures; replaced with qualitative budget/mid-range/luxury tiers plus a check-booking-sites note. Dropped the unsourced hotel-ranges evidence row.
CORRECTED the 421 duration to about 133 minutes (Moovit) and re-sourced the fare to the distance band; removed the unsourced pre-reform aside.
ADDED the Masada cable-car surcharge (expert MAJOR 8): official entry without versus with the cable car, and that tourist cards do not cover it.
Rewrote domain-checklist.md to verified figures and evidence-backed sources; moved the percent-encoded Hebrew Moovit URL out of the checklist so encoded Hebrew URLs live only in evidence.json.
deviations: pti.org.il (official Ministry of Transport tariff) and guberman differ on the up-to-225 km single ride; used the official pti.org.il figure.
Masada cable-car figures use the official INPA combined-ticket prices rather than third-party operator round-trip quotes.
Matmon couple/family tiers were not confirmable on the official page, so only the individual tier is stated as a number.

cycles.trigger: Batch2 drift-type-C review: external-site dependency and link rot.
changes: CRITICAL FIX: all six bus daily caps were wrong. The published set (11.5/21/27/30.5/52.5, over-225 'no cap') was a verbatim transcription of the TRAIN single-ride column of the same official table. Correct bus caps are 17.5/29/37.5/37.5/60.5/79.5, and every band has a cap. Verified twice independently in a rendered browser at bus.gov.il/FaresDistance.
Replaced the dead fare source: pti.org.il/DerekhShava/ now 301s to bus.gov.il and serves an empty SPA shell to non-browser fetchers. All fare claims re-sourced to bus.gov.il/FaresDistance.
Added the Tzedek Tachburti rider-profile discount scheme, verified at bus.gov.il/Discounts, including the profile-registration prerequisite, the no-stacking rule and mandatory validation.
Added chagim to the Shabbat section (Yom Tov shutdown, erev-chag wind-down, Chol HaMoed crowding) and reframed Yom Kippur as practical effect rather than a legal claim.
Rewrote weekend-transit guidance as a per-city check instead of the blanket 'no transit on Shabbat', without publishing an unsourced municipality list.

Brought driving and car rental into scope (Highway 6 barrier-free rebilling, rental eligibility, parking) because both worked examples route the traveler into a car while the checklist disclaimed the topic.
Added a Ben Gurion Airport ground-transport section.
Added Masada gate timings, the 08:00 cable-car start (so a sunrise ascent is on foot), heat-load cutoffs and the advance visit-coordination booking, all from the operator page.
Removed the Matmon 181 NIS figure: it was cited to the INPA price list, which I rendered in full and which contains no Matmon price. Replaced with the water-sites 50% rule that the page does state.
Flagged that line 421 runs by advance reservation on weekdays, which undermined the weekend Dead Sea example; demoted it in favour of a rental car.
Added a Reference Links / קישורי עזר section, which the skill lacked entirely.
Fixed metadata.json category, which said 'localization' rather than 'travel'.

Rewrote scripts/plan_route.py: Hebrew city aliases, a Ben Gurion node, --list, 20 more city pairs, real direct-train routes that were previously denied, non-zero exit on unknown input, and it now computes the Derech Shava band with the bus-vs-combined-rail column warning instead of telling the user to look it up.
deviations: Could not source the Neim BeSofash municipality roster from any live official page (gov.il and bus.gov.il paths both dead), so the weekend-service guidance is written as a per-city instruction rather than a named list.
Could not source the Eilat VAT carve-out list, so the skill states that exclusions exist and routes to the Tax Authority rather than enumerating them.
Israel Railways EMV acceptance was previously asserted on the strength of a 2018 tender article written in the future tense. Downgraded to UNVERIFIED and the assertion removed from all four surfaces.
Could not verify any Matmon tier price; no figure is stated.
lessons: CARRY: Israel Railways EMV acceptance is still unverified. Confirm on rail.co.il next cycle.
CARRY: the Eilat fare regime is genuinely separate (Wikivoyage shows a distinct Eilat fare column and a Zone 1 Eilat monthly). Not covered; source it from bus.gov.il next cycle.

CARRY: accessibility is covered only as a fare-discount profile. Rail assistance-booking lead times and per-site INPA accessibility are absent; the Masada sunrise guidance routes every reader onto the Snake Path with no alternative for a mobility-limited traveler.
CARRY: Dead Sea beach access omits the free Ein Bokek public facilities and the hotel day-use model.

CARRY: hotel-chain and Zimmerim entries are brand-to-tier filler; the booking mechanics that actually change a decision (weekend minimum stays, direct booking, kosher dining and Shabbat-mode constraints) are missing.
Deferred over the Phase 4.1 cap: park opening hours in the reference guide are unsourced and not reconciled with the Friday/chag early-closing rule.

METHOD: the daily-cap error was a wrong-column read from a six-column table that survived three cycles because every gate checked whether the stated number was correct, and it was, in the column it came from. When transcribing any multi-column rate table, record WHICH column each figure came from in the evidence claim text.
